problems.title: Sum of complementary sines
problems.question: Simplify sin 25°+cos 55°.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: $\cos55°=\sin35°$; $\sin p+\sin q=2\sin((p+q)/2)\cos((p-q)/2)$.
steps: The sum is 2sin30°cos 5°=cos 5°.

problems.title: A sine-cosine product
problems.question: Simplify $\sin(\alpha-\beta)\cos(\beta-\alpha)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Cosine is even and $2\sin t\cos t=\sin2t$.
steps: Put t=α−β and apply the double-angle identity.

problems.title: A tangent half-angle value
problems.question: Find sinα+cosα if tan(α/2)=3.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: With t=tan(α/2), $\sin\alpha=2t/(1+t^2)$ and $\cos\alpha=(1-t^2)/(1+t^2)$.
steps: At t=3 these are 3/5 and −4/5. Add them.

problems.title: Count two prisms
problems.question: A prism has 10 space diagonals. Its edge count equals another prism’s face count. Find the second prism’s vertex count.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: An n-gonal prism has $n(n-3)$ space diagonals,3n edges, n+2 faces, and 2n vertices.
steps: n(n−3)=10 gives n=5. Thus the first has 15 edges. The second has 15 faces, so its base has 13 sides and it has 26 vertices.

problems.title: Total area of an equilateral triangular prism
problems.question: All edges of a regular triangular prism have length 4. Find its total are a.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Total are a is $Ph+2S_{base}$.
steps: The lateral are a is(3·4)·4=48. Each equilateral base are a is 4²√3/4=4√3. Add both.

problems.title: Fundamental sine period
problems.question: Find the least positive period of $7\sin(0.1\pi x+7\pi/18)-2\pi$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: For nonzero frequency k, the period of sin(kx+c) is $2\pi/|k|$.
steps: Here k=π/10, so the period is 2π/(π/10).

problems.title: A quotient of trigonometric sums
problems.question: Simplify $(\sin\alpha+\sin\beta)/(\cos\alpha+\cos\beta)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Use sum-to-product formulas: numerator $2\sin((\alpha+\beta)/2)\cos((\alpha-\beta)/2)$, denominator $2\cos((\alpha+\beta)/2)\cos((\alpha-\beta)/2)$.
steps: On the original nonzero-denominator domain, the shared cosine factor is nonzero and cancels.

problems.title: Hexagonal prism height ratio
problems.question: A regular hexagonal prism has lateral are a to total are a ratio 1:3. Find height divided by base side.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: For base side a, height h, $L=6ah$ and $2S=3\sqrt3a^2$. The ratio gives $3L=L+3\sqrt3a^2$.
steps: Thus 12ah=3√3a². Divide by 12a².

problems.title: A second-angle tangent quotient
problems.question: Find $(\sin\alpha-2\sin2\alpha+\sin3\alpha)/(\cos\alpha-2\cos2\alpha+\cos3\alpha)$ if tanα=−3.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Sum-to-product gives numerator $2\sin2\alpha(\cos\alpha-1)$ and denominator $2\cos2\alpha(\cos\alpha-1)$.
steps: On the given domain cancellation leaves tan 2α=2tanα/(1−tan²α)=−6/(1−9).

problems.title: Range of a cosine difference
problems.question: Find the range of $\cos(2x+13\pi/15)-\cos(2x+\pi/5)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: $\cos u-\cos v=-2\sin((u+v)/2)\sin((u-v)/2)$.
steps: The half phase difference is π/3, so the amplitude is 2sinπ/3=√3. The variable sine attains every value in[−1,1].

problems.title: Box space diagonal from face diagonals
problems.question: Three adjacent face diagonals of a rectangular box are 5,√34,√41. Find its space diagonal.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: The squares of the three face diagonals sum to $2(a^2+b^2+c^2)$.

problems.title: Does a right triangular prism’s area follow?
problems.question: A right triangular prism has base are a 8 and triangle ABC₁ are a 10. Find its lateral are a.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Let AB=a, base altitude from C be t, and prism height h. Then $at/2=8$ and $(a/2)\sqrt{t^2+h^2}=10$, giving ah=12.
steps: Lateral are a is h times the whole base perimeter, which ah alone does not determine. For example take a=4, t=4, h=3. Bases C=(2,4) and C=(0,4), with A=(0,0), B=(4,0), both meet the two are a conditions. Their lateral areas are 12+12√5 and 24+12√2, respectively.
If the base were additionally equilateral, its perimeter would be 3a and lateral are a 3ah=36, the likely intended listed answer.
problems.answer: Insufficient data for a general right triangular prism;36 if its base is equilateral.
problems.note: “Right prism” specifies perpendicular lateral edges. It does not require a regular/equilateral base; that extra condition is missing.

problems.title: A product of cosine sums
problems.question: Simplify $\sin^2\alpha+\sin^2\beta+\cos(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: $\cos(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)=\cos^2\alpha-\sin^2\beta$.
steps: The β terms cancel, leaving sin²α+cos²α.

problems.title: Horizontal line meets a trigonometric graph
problems.question: For which a do y=2a and y=2sin²x+sin x+1 meet?
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Put t=sin x∈[−1,1]. The latter value is $2(t+1/4)^2+7/8$.
steps: Its minimum is 7/8 at t=−1/4; its maximum on the interval is 4 at t=1. Thus 2a∈[7/8,4].

problems.title: A square diagonal and a plane
problems.question: A square’s plane meets plane P along side AD at dihedral angle α, with sinα=√2/3. Find the sine of the angle its diagonal makes with P.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: For square side s, the opposite diagonal endpoint is at distance $s\sin\alpha$ from P, and the diagonal length is s√2.
steps: Thus sinβ=(s sinα)/(s√2)=sinα/√2. Substitute√2/3.

problems.title: A cosine times a tangent correction
problems.question: Evaluate $\cos10°(1+\tan10°\tan5°)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: The expression is $[\cos10°\cos5°+\sin10°\sin5°]/\cos5°$.
steps: The numerator is cos(10°−5°)=cos 5°. It cancels the nonzero denominator.

problems.title: A hexagonal prism from diagonal sums
problems.question: From a vertex of a regular hexagonal prism, the three space diagonal lengths sum to 2√37+√41. A lateral-face diagonal is √29. Find lateral are a.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: For base side a, height h, the three space lengths are $\sqrt{h^2+3a^2},\sqrt{h^2+3a^2},\sqrt{h^2+4a^2}$. Also h²+a²=29.
steps: Writing t=a², their sum is 2√(29+2t)+√(29+3t), a strictly increasing function of t≥0. At t=4 it equals exactly 2√37+√41, so this is the unique solution. Then a=2, h=5. Lateral are a=6ah.

problems.title: Two cotangents whose angles sum to45°
problems.question: Evaluate $(1-\cot23°)(1-\cot22°)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: The cotangent addition formula gives $\cot23°\cot22°-1=\cot45°(\cot23°+\cot22°)$.
steps: Since cot 45°=1, the product of the two cotangents equals 1 plus their sum. Expanding the requested product then gives 1−sum+(1+sum)=2.

problems.title: Integers outside a trigonometric-radical domain
problems.question: How many integers in[−4,10] are outside the domain of $\sqrt{25-4x^2}/(\sin(\pi x/2)-1)$?
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: The radical requires $|x|\le5/2$, leaving integer candidates−2,−1,0,1,2.
steps: The denominator vanishes at x=1 among those five. Hence only 4 of the 15 integers in[−4,10] are valid. Subtract 4 from 15.

problems.title: Distance to a dihedral edge
problems.question: Inside a60° dihedral angle, a point has distances 3 and 6 from its two faces. Find its distance to the edge.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: In a cross-section perpendicular to the edge, take one face as y=0 and the other as a60° ray. If the first distance is p and the second q, then $\rho^2=(p^2+q^2+2pq\cos60°)/\sin^260°$.
steps: This formula follows from y=p and x sin 60°−y cos 60°=q, then ρ²=x²+y². Substituting p=3, q=6 gives(9+36+18)/(3/4)=84.

problems.title: Lateral area from two diagonal sections
problems.question: The diagonal-section planes of a right parallelepiped meet at 60° and their areas are 3,4. Find lateral are a.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Let the base-diagonal vectors be u, v and prism height h. Then |hu|=3,|hv|=4, and their angle is 60°. Base-side vectors are $(u+v)/2,(u-v)/2$.
steps: Thus the products of height and the two side lengths are √(9+16+12)/2=√37/2 and √(9+16−12)/2=√13/2. Twice their sum is the lateral are a.

problems.title: Range width of a trigonometric expression
problems.question: Find maximum minus minimum of $6\tan2\alpha/(1+\tan^22\alpha)-(4-4\tan^22\alpha)/(1+\tan^22\alpha)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: The expression is $3\sin4\alpha-4\cos4\alpha$, whose amplitude is $\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$.
steps: Both extrema±5 are attained where the original tangent is defined: their phase conditions do not force cos 2α=0. Thus the width is 5−(−5).

problems.title: A triple-angle product
problems.question: Evaluate $\sin75°/(\sin25°\sin35°\sin85°)$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: $\sin3t=4\sin t\sin(60°+t)\sin(60°-t)$.
steps: Use t=25°. The numerator is exactly 4 times the three denominator factors, all nonzero.

problems.title: Three lateral faces of an oblique prism
problems.question: A prism has equilateral base side 5 and lateral edge 6. One lateral edge makes the same acute angle α with both adjacent base edges, with sinα=2/3. Find lateral are a.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: Two lateral parallelogram faces each have are a $5\cdot6\sin\alpha=20$. The lateral vector has equal dot products with the unit directions of those adjacent base edges.
steps: Their difference is parallel to the third base edge, so the lateral vector is perpendicular to that third edge. The remaining lateral face therefore has are a 5·6=30. Total are a is 20+20+30.

problems.title: A long cosine product
problems.question: Evaluate $\cos4°\cos8°\cdots\cos88°$.
problems.idea: Reduce the trigonometry or geometry to exact standard formulas.
formulas: For $\theta=\pi/45=4°$, $\cos(k\theta)=\sin(2k\theta)/(2\sin(k\theta))$.
steps: Multiply for k=1,…,22. After folding angles over 90° using sin(π−t)=sin t, the numerator factors are the same sine values as the denominator factors in a different order: the numbers min(2k,45−2k) run through 1,…,22. All factors cancel except 2²².
